'''2013 SoCal Grand Prix Day 2 Matthew Harrison-Trainor LS Watch Your Step (V)''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Matthew Harrison-Trainor]] at [[2013 SoCal Grand Prix]] (Day 2).

Day 2 Light change sheet headed Same (the Day 1 Watch Your Step list). OUT Corellian Slip, Corellian Retort (one copy), It's A Trap, Evacuation Control, Desperate Reach, Houjix combo, Fallen Jedi. IN Booster Terrik, 2 Escape Pod, Houjix, Grimtaash, Leia's Blaster (Leia's Sporting Blaster), Captain Yutani With Blaster Cannon. Day 1 typed pages are on this article with the change sheet.

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[Watch Your Step (V) / This Place Can Be A Little Rough (V)]]
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
